DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilq.qov.ph DILG OPINION No. 109 s. 2021 AUG 25 2021 DIRECTOR LEOCADIO T. TROVELA Regional Director, DILG-Region VII Sudlon, Lahug, Cebu City Dear Regional Director Trovela: This has reference to your 4th Indorsement dated 25 May 2021 regarding the query from the Sangguniang Panlalawigan Steering Council on the propriety of the Sangguniang Bayan of Bacong, Negros Oriental in approving their Annual Investment Program through Resolution No. 408-8 and Resolution No. I I, series of 2020 with the attendance of the Presiding Officer, Vice-Mayor Jocelyn A. Alviola, being done by teleconferencing since she was out of the country. Based on the documents forwarded to the Central Office, Vice-Mayor Alviola was out of the country. While abroad, she still attended the session of the Sangguniang Bayan via teleconferencing. Said session however was presided by SB Member Simplicia V. Baro as Acting Presiding Officer. This session paved the way for the approval of their Annual Investment Program through Resolutions No. 408-8 and Resolution No. II, series of 2020. We note that the nature of foreign travel by Vice-Mayor Alviola was not disclosed in the documents forwarded to the Central Office. However, be it an official foreign travel as defined under Section 9 of EO 77, series of 20191 or personal foreign travel supported by a duly approved leave of absence, both travel abroad and leave of absence are grounds of temporary vacancy in a local elective office provided under Section 46 (a) of Republic Act No. 7160 or the Local Government Code of 1991, to wit: "SECTION 46. Temporary Vacancy in the Office of the Local Chief Executive. - (a) When the governor, city or municipal Mayor, or Punong Barangay is temporarily incapacitated to perform his duties for physical or legal reasons such as, but not limited to, leave of absence travel abroad, and suspension from office, the vice-govemor, city or municipal vice-mayor, or the highest ranking Sangguniang Barangay member shall automatically 1 Entitled "Prescribing Rules and Regulations and Rates of Expenses and Allowances for Official Local and Foreign Travels of Government Personnel". "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

exercise the powers and perform the duties and functions of the local chief executive concerned, except the power to appoint, suspend, or dismiss employees which can only be exercised if the period of temporary incapacity exceeds thirty (30) working days. xxxx (Emphasis Supplied) Since there was a temporary vacancy in the Office of the Vice-Mayor at that time in view of her travel abroad or leave of absence, accordingly, her attendance during said session should not be considered in the determination of quorum and that she should not be allowed to participate in the deliberation on the adoption of the aforesaid Resolutions. Arguendo, if the sanggunian allowed her attendance in the determination of quorum more so material in mustering the required quorum, then such session conducted appears to be irregular. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have guided you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, Y T AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: MARLO AN for Local Government : DILG ; LLLS/RPB/LRA LLD/clp/OUSLG-ao Page 2 of 2
